resources.string: A transparent, user-started demonstration for current Android devices.

This application and its source are for testing, demonstrations, and ethical purposes in an isolated environment only.

Use only on devices you own or have explicit permission to test.

Stop if permission is withdrawn.
This build can run only a visible demo session for up to 60 minutes. It requests notification permission so the Stop control remains visible. It has no network or device-data access.
Demo session active. You can stop it here or from the notification.
Starting creates an ongoing low-priority notification. Tapping the notification returns to this screen.
The session stops automatically after 60 minutes and never starts at boot or restarts itself.
The demo session could not start. Review system notification settings and try again.
Notification permission is required because this demo never runs without visible controls.
Visible controls for a user-started, time-limited ethical demo session.
Tap to review. This visible session stops automatically after 60 minutes.
Runs only a visible, user-started, time-limited demo notification.

• No connection to the legacy dashboard\n• No SMS, call log, microphone, location, contact, file, or network access\n• No boot launch, hidden execution, self-restart, analytics, or unbounded persistence

1. Obtain explicit written authorization.
2. Define the devices, data, actions, and time window in scope.
3. Use isolated test accounts and devices.
4. Provide a clear stop and data-deletion process.
Closing this screen does not hide the active session: its notification stays visible. Use Stop in the app or notification; otherwise it ends after 60 minutes.
